meadow:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Primary input image: approved artistic mood/palette/brush reference ONLY. Extract its serious late-autumn dark-fantasy soot, slate, umber and desaturated dried-ochre color language and sparse selected dark-ink + flat wash rendering. DO NOT reproduce the reference scenery or perspective.
Create ONE square 2D game diffuse MATERIAL SWATCH, flat perfectly overhead. It will be projected and rotated by runtime geometry.
CRITICAL: ground is MUCH QUIETER than detailed reference objects. At least 85 percent calm unmarked matte pigment washes. Broad smooth low-contrast wash transitions with only VERY FEW selected brush breaks/ink marks. NO granular/noisy/stippled carpet, no fine exhaustive grass/leaf marks, no paper grain, no busy all-over texture. Dark atmosphere comes from palette, not grain. Serious natural realism of drawing, no cute/rounded cartoon motifs.
Full-bleed uniform square, seamless repeat-friendly opposite edges, no borders/vignette/frame/hex tile, no scene/objects/icons, no baked perspective/horizon, no directional light or shadow, no text. Neutral diffuse surface with no height relief. Single swatch only, no showcase. Aim for 1024x1024 opaque RGB.
MATERIAL: exhausted late-autumn meadow surface. Depleted cool grey-sage mixed with soot gray and muted dry-ochre earth; very low saturation, predominantly gray-brown with slight sage undertone, NO green lawn. Broad calm washes, only a handful of fine broken dried-grass strokes across the whole square. No grass tufts, clumps, plants or lush foliage.
